footnote_text: The Reporting Person previously reported direct ownership of the securities held in an individual account. Effective November 25, 2026, the securities were transferred to a trust held as joint tenants, of which the Reporting Person and spouse are co-trustees and co-beneficiaries. Accordingly, the form of ownership has changed from direct ownership to indirect ownership through a joint tenants trust.

On November 25, 2026, 35,578.105 shares of restricted stock units vested. The restricted stock units were previously reported as beneficially owned by the Reporting Person. Pursuant to the terms of the award agreement these shares were withheld by the Issuer to satisfy tax withholding obligations.
